title: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion during peak batch load
error_signature: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved / too many clients already
root_cause: Application connection pool max size was set higher than the database max_connections limit, causing pool saturation during nightly batch jobs.
resolution_steps: Lowered application-side pool max size below db max_connections minus reserved superuser slots
Enabled PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode
Added alerting on active connection count > 80% of max_connections

title: PLC Modbus TCP communication timeout on line 3
error_signature: Modbus TCP read timeout after 3 retries / no response from slave device
root_cause: Intermittent network switch port flapping on the OT VLAN caused packet loss between the SCADA gateway and PLC.
resolution_steps: Replaced faulty SFP module on the affected switch port
Reduced Modbus polling interval and added exponential backoff
Added redundant network path for OT VLAN

title: Docker container OOMKilled during image processing spike
root_cause: Memory limit set too low for peak workload; a burst of high-resolution images caused memory usage to exceed the container cgroup limit.
resolution_steps: Increased container memory limit and requests
Implemented image downsampling before processing
Added horizontal pod autoscaling based on memory pressure

title: Cascading failure from database outage to dependent microservices
root_cause: Primary database failover took longer than the service timeout, causing upstream services without circuit breakers to queue requests and exhaust thread pools.
resolution_steps: Implemented circuit breaker pattern with fast-fail on downstream unavailability
Added read replicas with automatic failover under 10 seconds
Introduced request queuing with backpressure

title: Repeated NullReferenceException in batch scheduler after config change
root_cause: A configuration migration removed a default value for a job parameter, and the code did not null-check before dereferencing it.
resolution_steps: Added null-check and default fallback in ScheduleRunner
Restored missing configuration default
Added schema validation for configuration files at startup

title: PLC sensor drift causing false-positive safety interlocks
error_signature: Safety interlock triggered / sensor value out of calibrated range
root_cause: Temperature sensor drifted out of calibration after 6 months of continuous operation, tripping safety thresholds under normal conditions.
resolution_steps: Recalibrated affected sensors
Implemented scheduled calibration reminders
Added sensor health diagnostics to the PLC dashboard

title: Disk space exhaustion on log volume causing application crash
error_signature: No space left on device / write failed to /var/log
root_cause: Log rotation policy was misconfigured, allowing debug-level logs to accumulate unbounded over several weeks.
resolution_steps: Fixed logrotate configuration with size and time-based rotation
Reduced default log level from DEBUG to INFO in production
Added disk usage alerting at 80% threshold

title: Docker daemon unresponsive due to orphaned container buildup
error_signature: Error response from daemon: dial unix docker.sock: connect: resource temporarily unavailable
root_cause: Failed deployment retries created hundreds of orphaned stopped containers, exhausting the daemon's internal state handling capacity.
resolution_steps: Pruned orphaned containers and dangling images
Fixed deployment script to clean up failed containers before retrying
Added scheduled docker system prune job

title: PostgreSQL deadlock storm during concurrent inventory updates
error_signature: deadlock detected / process holds lock and waits for another
root_cause: Two stored procedures updated the same rows in inventory and order tables in opposite lock order under high concurrency.
resolution_steps: Standardized lock acquisition order across stored procedures
Reduced transaction scope and added retry-on-deadlock logic
Added deadlock monitoring and alerting

title: PLC-to-MES data desync after network partition
error_signature: Stale data warning / last sync timestamp exceeded threshold
root_cause: A brief network partition between the PLC gateway and MES caused queued messages to be dropped instead of buffered, resulting in state desynchronization.
resolution_steps: Implemented persistent message queue (buffering) for PLC-MES sync
Added reconciliation job to detect and correct desynced state
Added network partition detection with automatic resync trigger

title: Memory leak in application service leading to gradual degradation
error_signature: GC overhead limit exceeded / gradually increasing response latency
root_cause: An event listener was registered but never unregistered on each request, causing unbounded growth of subscriber lists over time.
resolution_steps: Fixed listener lifecycle to unregister on request completion
Added memory profiling to CI pipeline
Set up automatic restart policy as a temporary mitigation

title: Container image pull failure due to registry authentication expiry
root_cause: Registry service account credentials expired and were not rotated automatically, blocking new container deployments.
resolution_steps: Rotated and renewed registry credentials
Automated credential rotation with secrets manager integration
Added pre-deployment authentication health check

title: PLC firmware bug causing intermittent watchdog resets
error_signature: Watchdog reset triggered / unexpected controller reboot
root_cause: A known firmware bug in a specific PLC firmware version caused the watchdog timer to trigger under specific I/O load patterns.
resolution_steps: Applied vendor firmware patch
Added reboot event logging and alerting
Scheduled firmware audit across all line controllers

title: Slow PostgreSQL queries after missing index post-migration
error_signature: Query execution time > 30s / sequential scan on large table
root_cause: A schema migration dropped an index that was not recreated, causing the query planner to fall back to full table scans on a growing table.
resolution_steps: Recreated the missing index
Added migration checklist requiring index verification
Enabled slow query logging with automated review

title: Multi-service outage triggered by expired TLS certificate
error_signature: SSL handshake failed / certificate has expired
root_cause: The TLS certificate renewal automation silently failed weeks earlier without alerting, and the certificate expired during business hours.
resolution_steps: Manually renewed and deployed the certificate
Fixed the renewal automation and added failure alerting
Added certificate expiry monitoring with 30/14/7-day warnings
